var res = JSON.parse(result);
var bookList = [];
var tabs = res && res.search_tabs ? res.search_tabs : [];
function isArray(value) {
  return Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Array]';
}
for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
  var tab = tabs[i];
  if (!tab || String(tab.tab_type) !== '8' || !isArray(tab.data)) continue;
  for (var j = 0; j < tab.data.length; j++) {
    var item = tab.data[j];
    if (item && isArray(item.book_data)) {
      for (var k = 0; k < item.book_data.length; k++) {
        if (item.book_data[k]) bookList.push(item.book_data[k]);
      }
    } else if (item && item.book_data) {
      bookList.push(item.book_data);
    } else if (item && item.book_id) {
      bookList.push(item);
    }
  }
}
JSON.stringify(bookList)

<js>
$=java.getString('.leftx@html')
n = 0; 
v = book.getVariable("custom");
x = v.match(/^\d+$/)? v : n;
//x = (parseInt(x) < $.length)? x : n;
java.toast(x)
name=java.getString('.bookTitle@text');
author=`{{book.author}}`;
last=java.getString('#list-chapterAll@a@text')
kind=java.getString('.col-md-12@p.1@text')

if (v == 0) {
  bookUrlz = baseUrl;
  book.type = 8;
  java.toast('已自动开启小说模式');
} else if(v==1){
  bookUrlz =String(java.getString('.leftx@a@onclick')).replace(/.*\(\'(.*?)\'\)/,'$1');
  book.type = 128;
  java.toast('已自动开启文件模式');
}
intro = " 简介：" + java.getString('.bookIntro@text') + "\n当前源链: " + "\n"+bookUrlz+"\n书籍文本:🔺'+【0】+'🔻"+'\n'+baseUrl+
"\n文件链接:🔺'+【1】+'🔻"+'\n'+String(java.getString('.leftx@a@onclick')).replace(/.*\(\'(.*?)\'\)/,'$1');
data = {
	name:name,
	author:author,
	last:last,
	kind:kind,
	intro:intro,
	bookUrl:bookUrlz
};

JSON.stringify(data);
</js>
